primarySources.author: Olivelle, Patrick (trans.)
primarySources.title: The Early Upaniṣads: Annotated Text and Translation
primarySources.description: Authoritative contemporary critical edition providing philologically rigorous translations, extensive Sanskrit critical apparatus, and detailed historical introductions for the older prose Upaniṣads.

primarySources.author: Radhakrishnan, Sarvepalli
primarySources.title: The Principal Upaniṣads
primarySources.description: Monumental bilingual edition with Roman transliteration, comprehensive English rendering, and exhaustive philosophical notes drawing cross-cultural parallels between Vedānta and Western metaphysics.

primarySources.author: Müller, F. Max (trans.)
primarySources.title: The Upaniṣads (Sacred Books of the East)
primarySources.description: Foundational public-domain translation of the major Upaniṣads in the historic Sacred Books of the East series, providing landmark 19th-century European scholarly engagement with Vedic literature.

primarySources.author: Gambhirananda, Swami (trans.)
primarySources.title: Eight Upaniṣads with the Commentary of Śaṅkarācārya
primarySources.description: Standard English rendering of Śaṅkara's authoritative Sanskrit commentaries (Bhāṣyas) on Īśā, Kena, Kaṭha, Taittirīya, Aitareya, Muṇḍaka, Māṇḍūkya, and Praśna Upaniṣads.

primarySources.author: Madhavananda, Swami (trans.)
primarySources.title: The Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad with the Commentary of Śaṅkarācārya
primarySources.description: Complete, scholarly English translation of the immense Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad along with Śaṅkara's extensive philosophical commentary.

primarySources.author: Easwaran, Eknath
primarySources.title: The Upanishads: A Classic Translation
primarySources.description: Lyrical, accessible rendering prioritizing contemplative clarity and psychological resonance for general contemporary readers.

indianPsychology.author: Rao, K. Ramakrishna & Paranjpe, Anand C.
indianPsychology.title: Psychology in the Indian Tradition
indianPsychology.description: Comprehensive academic textbook mapping classical Indian epistemological, cognitive, emotional, and transcendent models to contemporary psychological constructs.

indianPsychology.author: Paranjpe, Anand C.
indianPsychology.title: Self and Identity in Modern Psychology and Indian Thought
indianPsychology.description: Groundbreaking comparative study contrasting Western theories of ego development (Erikson, Rogers) with Advaitic and Yogic models of consciousness and identity.

indianPsychology.author: Swami Akhilananda
indianPsychology.title: Hindu Psychology: Its Meaning for the West
indianPsychology.description: Pioneering early 20th-century treatise presenting classical Vedāntic mental training, emotion regulation, and meditation to Western clinical psychology audiences.

indianPsychology.author: Swami Rama, Ballentine, Rudolph & Swami Ajaya
indianPsychology.title: Yoga and Psychotherapy: The Evolution of Consciousness
indianPsychology.description: Synthesis of classical Indian kosha models with Western psychodynamic, behavioral, humanistic, and transpersonal therapeutic paradigms.

indianPsychology.author: Deussen, Paul
indianPsychology.title: The Philosophy of the Upanishads
indianPsychology.description: Masterwork of 19th-century German Indology systematizing the theology, cosmology, and psychology of the Vedic texts.

indianPsychology.author: Cohen, Signe (ed.)
indianPsychology.title: The Upaniṣads: A Complete Guide
indianPsychology.description: Comprehensive contemporary reference volume featuring chapters on historical context, philosophy, ritual, gender, and reception history by leading global scholars.

modernResilience.author: Masten, Ann S.
modernResilience.title: Ordinary Magic: Resilience Processes in Development
modernResilience.description: Seminal paper demonstrating that human resilience is not a rare superhuman anomaly, but arises from ordinary, normative adaptive human protective systems.

modernResilience.author: Bonanno, George A.
modernResilience.title: Loss, Trauma, and Human Resilience: Have We Underestimated the Human Capacity to Thrive?
modernResilience.description: Landmark longitudinal research distinguishing true resilience (stable trajectories of healthy functioning) from recovery and chronic trauma.

modernResilience.author: Frankl, Viktor E.
modernResilience.title: Man's Search for Meaning
modernResilience.description: Existential psychiatric classic detailing how discovering meaning and an unshakeable inner spiritual freedom enables survival through extreme catastrophic adversity.

modernResilience.author: Tedeschi, Richard G. & Calhoun, Lawrence G.
modernResilience.title: Posttraumatic Growth: Conceptual Foundations and Empirical Evidence
modernResilience.description: Empirical framework examining positive psychological transformation, increased personal strength, and existential depth following severe life crises.

modernResilience.author: Seligman, Martin E.P.
modernResilience.title: Flourish: A Visionary New Understanding of Happiness and Well-being
modernResilience.description: Introduces the PERMA model of positive psychology and explores comprehensive soldier fitness and cognitive resilience training.

modernResilience.author: Kabat-Zinn, Jon
modernResilience.title: Full Catastrophe Living: Using the Wisdom of Your Body and Mind to Face Stress, Pain, and Illness
modernResilience.description: Foundational clinical manual introducing Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR), adapting contemplative attentional and witness practices for modern behavioral medicine.
